note: Parallel regrade of the SAME published calls under alternative exit rules. Matched samples: each comparison row uses only episodes resolved under BOTH rules, so columns are apples-to-apples. Diagnostic only -- the official ledger and win rate are unchanged.
caveat: Young-ledger bias: until enough calls are >=30 bars old, the h30 matched sample over-represents stopped trades (a stop is the only way to resolve early), which understates the no-target variants. Read edges only once matched_n is well past ~100.
